name: vibe-catalysis
description: Build, relax, compare, and visualize heterogeneous-catalysis adsorption structures with ASE and FAIR-Chem UMA.

interface.shortDescription: Run ASE + UMA adsorption workflows from natural language.
interface.longDescription: Generate elemental fcc, bcc, or hcp metal surfaces, enumerate adsorption sites, preserve fixed slab layers, run FAIR-Chem UMA single-point or relaxation calculations, rank accepted structures, and produce energy plots with ASE-native top views.
defaultPrompt: Calculate CO adsorption on Cu(111) and compare sites.
Relax CHO on Fe(110) with the bottom layers fixed.
Compare CO and CHO adsorption and draw an energy profile.
